translation.name: Jamaw ta Marbinto: Kabarre ta Gala ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi iŋ daŋla

book.name: Roomen
book.title: Roomen Maktumne taat Pool siirtu ɗo gee ku Room

content: Gem kol siŋtay, ɗo bi ka Yuudinnar, maan kaak gelbiner rakiyo ho kaak nu indiy Buŋ-ak, illa a ŋuu gase jile.
Yuudinna zeeɗa gine riy ta Buŋdi, nun sa saadine. Kar riyco gay, ŋu gingitɗo iŋ ibine kaak taɓ ka Buŋdi.
Ŋu bal ibine baati taat maman Buŋ giniig gee ŋuu goye iŋ botol ɗo uŋji ho ŋu bariyiy botol ta maaniico di. Ampaa ko, botol taat Buŋ gintu-at, ŋu poociita.
Iisa Masi gintu a *gaanuun ka Muusa goyɗo pey kaate. Paa kat, ŋuur kuuk aamin iŋ ŋaara, Buŋ yaa ginin̰co ŋuu goye iŋ botol ɗo uŋji.
Jile ka gee okin̰co kuuk aamin ɗo Iisa Masi
Ɗo bi ka ŋuur kuuk bariya goye iŋ botol ɗo uŋji ka Buŋdi iŋ *gaanuun, meen̰ji nabi Muusa siir ɗo Kitamner aman : « Gem kaak karmiyaag gaanuun okin̰ji-ak yaa goye iŋ ŋaar di. »

Kar gay, an kaaw taat ŋu kaawtu ɗo bi ka *goye kaak iŋ botol kaak min ɗo imaandi. Kaaw-at a dak osenno ɗo adin̰ aman : « Waa yaa coone ka samaaner ? » Ya ampa-ak, ki pakira a Iisa Masi bal paaye misa walla ?
Dak kaawenno pey ɗo adin̰ aman : « Waa yaa paaye ɗo bee kaak sugulgul, wer kaak gee ku mate goyiyo ? » Ya pa-ak, ki pakira a Iisa Masi bal nooye min ɗo muuti walla ?
Kar gay, maan ka kaawindi-ak, ŋa maa ? Kii kaawe taat ŋu siirtu ɗo Kitamner aman : « Kaaw ta Buŋdi, taar as ko moota, ta goy ɗo bin̰ ho ɗo gelbinen̰. »
Ta taar-an ko kaaw taat ɗo bi ka imaandi taat gi gaariy ɗo geemir.
Ya ki pil bin̰ ɗo uŋco ka geemir a Iisa Masi, ŋaar *Rabbine, ho ya ki aamin ɗo gelbinen̰ kadar Buŋ nooyig min ɗo muuti, kii gase jile.
Asaan ŋaar kaak aamin ɗo gelbiney-ak, Buŋ ginig a ŋa goy iŋ botol ɗo uŋji, ho ŋaar kaak pil biy ɗo uŋco ka geemir-ak, Buŋ yaa jilin̰ji.
Ka seener, ŋu siir ɗo Kitamner aman : « Ay waan kaak aamin loci, sokan̰ diyaagɗo tak-tak. »
Ansi-ak, gaara kadar *Yuudinna iŋ gee kuuk Yuudinnaɗo, ŋuur sawa di. Asaan okin̰co, *Rabbinco rakki di. Ŋaar ko kaak gina selliŋkaw ɗo ay gem kaak ala iŋ siŋ kun̰ji.
Ka seener, ŋu siir ɗo Kitamner aman : « Ay gem kaak ala iŋ siŋ ku Rabbiner yaa gase jile. »
Ka seener gay, maman ŋuu indin̰ji ya ŋu bal aamine loci ? Maman ŋuu aamine ya ŋu bal dore ? Maman ŋuu dore ya waan balco gaare kaawo ?
Ho maman ŋuuco gaare kaawo ya waan balco n̰aame gee ? Uudin taat ŋu siirtu ɗo Kitamner aman : « Gee kuuk iya kabarranna ku samaane, ŋu miinaag adat ku geemir iŋ galal. »
Kar gay, min gee okin̰co, daarin̰ di ooyit Kabarre ta Gala. Uudin taat nabi Ezaayi siirtu ɗo Kitamner aman : « Gem kol Rabbiney, ni gaarcot kaawon̰, kar waa di icta ? »
Ansi-ak, gee kuuk aamine, imaanco asa min ɗo kaaw taat ŋu dortu, ho kaaw taat ŋu dortu-at asa min gaare ka kaawor ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi.
Ŋaar-ak, nu gin pey inde : Kabarre-at, ŋu bal dorin misa walla ? Ha’a, ka seener, ŋu dorit ko. Uudin taat ŋu siirtu ɗo Kitamner aman :

content.text: « Ɗo kiɗ okin̰ji, ŋu dorit gaaƴ ta gay gaare kaawor,
ho kaawco-at, ŋu gaarit ɗo duniin okintiti. »

content: Ŋaar-ak, naa inde pey : Kaaw-an, Yuudinna bal ibine baati walla ? An ko kaaw taat Buŋ kaawtu min awalle iŋ biy ka nabi Muusa. Ŋa kaaw aman :

content.text: « Naako giniŋko hasuudinay ɗo gee kuuk kuntoɗo,
ho naa gine kuu dapin̰e iŋ darre

content: Kar nabi Ezaayi zeeɗtu nam ŋa kaawtu bal kolaw kaaw taat asa min ɗo Buŋdi aman :

content.text: ho ŋuur kuuk indiginno yoo maanna, nu bayinco. »

content: Kar gay, ɗo bi ka gee ku Israyeel, Ezaayi gaaytu pey aman :

content.text: nu jaalaaco pise ɗo geemir a ŋuudu ase,
kar gay, ŋu karmiygitɗo kaawor ho ŋu newsidu kopo. »
